title: Physical Layer
content:
- ### Definition
  - Foundational layer encompassing hardware, networking infrastructure, and physical computing resources. Provides the tangible substrate upon which all higher-level software layers execute, including processors, memory, storage devices, and communication channels.

- ### Semantic Classification
  - owl-class:: infrastructure:PhysicalLayer
  - owl-role:: Object
  - belongs-to-domain:: [[Narrative Gold Mine]]

- ### Relationships
  - is-subclass-of:: [[ArchitecturalLayer]]
  - has-part:: [[Processing Hardware]], [[Memory Systems]], [[Storage Devices]], [[Network Hardware]], [[Power Distribution]]
  - enables:: [[Computation]], [[Data Storage]], [[Signal Transmission]], [[Resource Provisioning]]
  - bridges-to:: [[Infrastructure Layer]], [[Network Layer]] (domain: ngm)
  - implements:: [[Infrastructure Layer]]

- ### Content
  The Physical Layer represents the tangible hardware substrate of narrative systems. It encompasses all physical computing devices, networking equipment, and storage infrastructure that provide the computational power and connectivity required by higher-level layers. Physical constraints such as latency, bandwidth, and power consumption are primary concerns at this layer.
